mode: Review-only tasks; fixtures intentionally contain problems and are not a buildable app.
results: Store actual model/client versions, settings, findings, checks, elapsed time and reported usage locally under docs/. Mark each criterion pass, fail, or not-run, with evidence.

cases.prompt: Review BackgroundRefresh.swift before shipping. Identify correctness issues and propose minimal fixes. Explain what must be checked outside this snippet. Do not edit files.
criteria: Explains that earliestBeginDate does not guarantee an exact fifteen-minute schedule.
Connects expiration to cancelling and cleaning up the work task, instead of only reporting failure.
Addresses the completion/expiration race and exactly-once completion on a defined isolation domain.
Checks task registration timing, configured identifiers and capabilities without claiming they are verified from this snippet.
Does not claim real background scheduling or device checks were executed.

cases.prompt: Review EditorBridge.swift for bugs after repeated updates and parent-state changes. Preserve the UIKit/SwiftUI bridge. Do not edit files.
criteria: Identifies duplicate notification registrations during updates and missing cleanup.
Accounts for coordinator parent/callback state becoming stale and proposes updating it.
Avoids direct frame mutation when SwiftUI owns layout.
Considers text-update feedback/cursor behavior and tests removal/recreation.
Preserves the existing UIKit integration rather than requiring a full SwiftUI rewrite.

cases.prompt: Review PurchaseController.swift for correctness across purchase, app restart, and subscription changes. Describe scoped corrections and relevant tests. Do not edit files.
criteria: Rejects unlocking from an unverified payload or trusting a persisted local Boolean as purchase authority.
Defines an app/service-owned update listener independent of paywall visibility and prevents duplicate listener creation.
Reconciles current entitlements with product identity/type, revocation and subscription policy including grace periods.
Finishes only after successful delivery and accounts for pending, cancellation, error and duplicate results.
Separates consumable restoration from non-consumable/subscription entitlements and distinguishes configuration tests from sandbox/production evidence.

cases.prompt: Review RequestClient.swift, which is used for GET requests and payment POST requests. Propose a bounded, cancellation-aware request policy without replacing the app architecture. Do not edit files.
criteria: Requires an idempotency/reconciliation contract before replaying a payment POST.
Preserves task cancellation and meaningful terminal errors instead of swallowing them or returning empty data.
Validates HTTP status and classifies eligible retry failures.
Uses bounded attempts and overall deadlines with suitable backoff/jitter and server retry guidance.
Proposes deterministic transport/clock tests without adding arbitrary abstraction layers.

cases.prompt: Review ProfileCard.swift for long localized names, accessibility text sizes, and VoiceOver. Suggest minimal improvements, keeping the design intent. Do not edit files.
criteria: Identifies fixed font/height and single-line truncation risks at accessibility sizes.
Provides an appropriate accessible name for the icon-only save action.
Addresses adaptive layout and usable hit targets rather than simply adding a label.
Proposes actual large-text/long-locale and VoiceOver verification, distinguishing it from source review.

cases.prompt: Review LoadingTests.swift for deterministic verification of the loading state. Explain a minimal testing approach and relevant isolation requirements. Do not edit files.
criteria: Identifies that creating a Task does not guarantee it has started before the immediate assertion.
Uses a controllable dependency or explicit readiness handshake rather than arbitrary sleep/yield counts.
Checks both the intermediate loading state and completed state with proper UI isolation.
Does not treat a proposed test as executed or introduce an iOS 17 cutoff for Swift Testing.
